blocks.text: International Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (IPI) showcased Filipino ingenuity and homegrown wellness at the Philippine Exporters’ Trade Exposition & Forum 2026, held November 4–8 at SMX Convention Center Manila in Pasay City. The event brought together Filipino enterprises, industry leaders, and buyers to celebrate export excellence and explore international opportunities. Showcasing export-ready Filipino wellness IPI highlighted its diverse portfolio of trusted wellness brands, including Efficascent Oil, Omega, Casino, Bioderm, and Dr. Wong’s, featuring Philippine and export-market product versions. Visitors experienced the brands firsthand through complimentary massages featuring Omega and Efficascent liniments and fragrance sampling of Dr. Wong’s Papaya Bright.
